status: spec-stage catalog: transcribed daily-program timetables plus notional reconstructions; not yet wired into the engine
description: Schedule-conditioned shipboard event catalogs. Documented templates are transcribed from real daily-program documents (Princess Patter, Holland America THE DAILY, NCL Freestyle Daily, Silversea Chronicles class) archived as public PDFs — Tr-class primary sources. Templates whose day type is not covered by a document for that ship class are marked class 'notional' and carry an explicit construction_rule. Naval platforms (destroyer_baseline, fletcher_class_destroyer, legend_class_nsc, san_antonio_class_lpd) and legacy cruise hulls (messy_cruise_500, expedition_cruise_300) are out of scope for SHIP-RHYTHM-01.

conventions.time_format: HH:MM 24-hour ship-local time; windows crossing midnight wrap (e.g. ['21:00','01:00'])
conventions.window_semantics: [start, end] inclusive start, exclusive end. An event's participants occupy its venue(s) for the stated occupancy_share of the window, then egress on the stated egress_mode.
conventions.venue_roles: Portable venue names resolved to platform zone ids by venue_map in each ship_class_catalog entry. Zone ids are verbatim from data/platforms/<platform>/spatial_layout.json.
conventions.participation_fraction: Fraction of the eligible population attending, drawn per eligible agent per event occurrence (bernoulli_per_occurrence) unless stated otherwise.
conventions.occupancy_share: Fraction of the event window a drawn participant spends inside the venue; the remainder is transit/corridor time governed by the egress front.
conventions.egress_mode: synchronized_end = attendees leave on a shared clock at window end, producing a corridor front; rolling = continuous arrival/departure with no coherent front; windowed = arrivals constrained to a stated sub-window (e.g. tender tickets).
conventions.notional_marking: A day_template with class 'notional' is a reconstruction: no daily-program document exists for that hull. Its construction_rule states exactly how the entries were assembled.
conventions.sop_conditioning: sop_variants names match protocols.json 'name' fields. Each variant is an ordered set of overrides applied to the baseline template.

No real timetable exists; canonical convention is a three-watch rotation (alpha/beta/gamma, 8-hour duty periods) for bridge/engineering watchstanders, with a four-shift variant ordered by Capt. Jellico in TNG 'Chain of Command'. Construction rule for the notional catalogs states this verbatim.

event_class_definitions.meal_seating: Fixed-window dining service (breakfast, lunch, dinner) at a dining venue. Synchronized-ish egress at window end; seating staggering handled by the engine's stagger_meal_seating, not duplicated here.
event_class_definitions.show_performance: Timed seated performance (production show, comedy, movie). Strongest synchronized_end egress: full venue pours out on a shared clock.
event_class_definitions.scheduled_activity: Timed participatory activity (trivia, bingo, dance class, lecture, game show). Synchronized start and end; moderate participation.
event_class_definitions.open_venue: Continuous-operations venue with posted hours (casino, shops, spa, pools, gym, lounges, cafe). Rolling egress; participation = per-hour dwell probability.
event_class_definitions.embarkation_flow: Day-1 boarding surge: gangway/check-in flow, buffet surge, cabin availability, mandatory muster drill, sailaway.
event_class_definitions.disembarkation_flow: Final-morning off-load: early breakfast, staggered gangway calls by group.
event_class_definitions.port_call: Tender or gangway windows, shore-excursion dispatch, all-aboard deadline. On port days this is the dominant occupancy driver.
event_class_definitions.watch_turnover: Crew watch rotation boundaries. Cruise crews mostly work long single-duty hotel shifts; engineering/watchkeeping crews rotate. Starships use canonical watch sections.
event_class_definitions.cleaning_rotation: Housekeeping/service passes through stateroom corridors and public venues. Crew-only participation; relevant because it moves crew through passenger cabin corridors twice daily.
event_class_definitions.queue_event: Front events where a line forms in a corridor/lobby: tender-ticket distribution, shore-excursion desk, photo gallery, muster station check-in.

sop_conditioning.description: Public-health SOPs decay or rearrange the baseline template. Each key below is a protocols.json 'name'; each value lists the event-class-level transformation it applies. The full per-ship effect tables live in each catalog's sop_variants.
sop_conditioning.Galley Closure & Meal Isolation: Buffet self-service suspended (crew-served or closed); meal_seating events at buffet venues cancelled or converted to delivered-to-cabin.
sop_conditioning.Individual Symptomatic Confinement to Qu: Symptomatic agents exit the rhythm layer entirely: participation = 0, meals delivered.
sop_conditioning.General Confinement to Quarters: All passenger events cancelled; passengers occupy cabins except sanctioned egress windows; crew service reduced to essential watches + cabin delivery.
sop_conditioning.VSP-Threshold Mass Isolation: Public-venue events cancelled or capacity-capped; self-serve buffet closed (crew-served); port-call activity suspended.
sop_conditioning.Selective Passenger Confinement (Diamond: Passenger events cancelled; scheduled cabin-door meal delivery and supervised deck-airing rotations (documented Diamond Princess practice).
sop_conditioning.Replayed Cabin Quarantine of All Passeng: Identical occupancy effect to General Confinement; the rhythm layer treats it as the same rearrangement.
sop_conditioning.Surface Disinfection Protocol: No schedule change; cleaning_rotation events increase in frequency and move into occupied windows.
sop_conditioning.Enhanced Ventilation: No schedule change (ventilation is a route property, not a rhythm property).
sop_conditioning.Increased Diagnostic Cadence: Adds a queue_event class for scheduled screening/visit windows where present.

starship_galaxy.construction_rule: Fictional hull. Built from canonical Starfleet convention: three 8-hour watch sections (alpha ~08:00-16:00, beta ~16:00-24:00, gamma ~00:00-08:00) for duty-posted crew (bridge, engineering, security, sciences, medical); Ten Forward / lounges run continuous evening hours; crew mess services at watch boundaries. Families/civilians follow a school-day + leisure pattern. No port calls; away missions substitute at reduced population. Every event carries class 'notional'.

sea_day.construction_rule: Starship 'routine operations' day: watch boundaries at 08:00/16:00/24:00, crew mess at each boundary, evening leisure occupancy in Ten Forward and holodecks.

source.rule: alpha shift turnover 08:00; off-going gamma-section crew egress through corridor at the same instant

starship_constitution.construction_rule: Fictional hull, all-crew complement. Same three-watch convention as starship_galaxy; recreation runs through the mess deck and rec rooms rather than Ten Forward; no civilian passenger population.

sea_day.construction_rule: TOS routine operations: three watch sections, mess at watch boundaries, evening rec-room occupancy.
